# INVENTRAK — Admin Dashboard

> Inventory tracking and management system for Sylver Restaurant and Cafe Supplier.
> Built with React + Vite, backed by Supabase/SQLite/Firestore.

## What is this?
INVENTRAK is an internal admin dashboard for managing inventory, products,
stock movements, order inquiries, and analytics for a restaurant/cafe supplier.

## Key features
- Product catalog management (204 products)
- Real-time inventory tracking across multiple branch locations
- Stock movement recording (in/out/transfer)
- Order inquiry workflow (pending → approved → fulfilled)
- ABC analysis and demand forecasting
- OCR-based product scanning
- Role-based access control (Admin / Staff)
- Multi-factor authentication (TOTP)
- Sales analytics with monthly charts

## API
The backend API is documented at: /api/openapi.json
Base URL: https://inventrak-api.onrender.com

## Authentication
- Admin: full access to all modules
- Staff: inventory levels, stock movement, adjustments, transfers, scan & stock, optimization, reports
- Customer: mobile app only (cannot access admin)

INVENTRAK Development Team — Capstone Project
